title: watcher.health.json
description: Heartbeat of the PS watcher (MG3-002). Written atomically every ~5 s and on every phase change into %LOCALAPPDATA%\MG_Helper. Consumers (tray, diagnose.ps1) decide liveness ONLY by the age of lastHeartbeatUtc: <=15 s fresh, 15-30 s stale, >30 s or no file dead. watcher.ready is NOT proof of liveness.

schemaVersion.description: Bump only with a breaking change; readers must treat unknown versions as Unknown, never as Healthy.

pid.description: PID of the powershell.exe running gta-settings-watcher.ps1.

processStartUtc.description: Start time of that PID in UTC: a recycled PID produces a different value.

status.description: starting = init not finished (Degraded, not Healthy); stopping = normal exit in progress.

phase.description: Mirror of state.json phase. UnknownSession means protection is off for this session and must be visible in the UI.

gamePid.description: PID of the detected game process, or null outside a session.

lastHeartbeatUtc.description: UTC timestamp of the last write; the only liveness signal.

sequence.description: Monotonic counter of this watcher process; a restart resets it (processStartUtc changes too).

lastErrorCode.description: Last MG-E-xxxx code written to the log, or an empty string when none.
